fallback: Button not working? Copy this link into your browser:

verify.subject: Confirm your email for VocabX
verify.title: Welcome to VocabX!
verify.body: One step left: confirm that this email is yours. Then you are signed in right away, with your progress on all your devices.
verify.footer: The link works for a day. If you did not sign up for VocabX, simply ignore this letter.

already.subject: You already have a VocabX account
already.title: The account already exists
already.body: Someone tried to sign up with this email, but it already has an account. If that was you, simply sign in.
already.footer: If it was not you, there is nothing to do: your account is safe.

reset.subject: A new password for VocabX
reset.title: A new password
reset.body: Someone asked for a new password for the account with this email. If that was you, press the button and choose a new password.
reset.footer: The link works for an hour and only once. If you did not ask for anything, simply ignore this letter: your password stays the same.
